director.text: Namaste Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher hoon. Aaj perimeter seekhenge—cricket ground ki boundary jaisa. Tumhe cricket mein kya pasand hai?
haan, samajh aaya

Cricket pitch ek lamba rectangle hoti hai, lagbhag 20 m lambi aur 3 m chaudi. Pitch ke ek kone se chalna shuru karo, kinaare-kinaare chalo aur wapas usi kone par pahuncho, toh jitni doori tay hui, wahi pitch ka parimap hai. Achha, Riya. Cricket pitch ke chaaron kinaaron par chaloge, toh shuru wale kone par lautoge.
haan samajh gayi
Is triangle ki teen bhuja hain: 4 cm, 5 cm aur 6 cm. Ek kone se chalo, teeno bhujaon se hote hue wapas usi kone par aao—yeh poora raasta parimap hai. Toh is triangle ka parimap kitna hai?

Achha, ab samajh aaya tumne kaise socha. Guess nahi—polygon ke boundary ki har bhuja jodte hain. Yeh hexagon hai. Iski chhah bhujayein hain aur sab barabar lambi hain. Label sirf ek bhuja par hai, 5 cm. Baaki bhujaon par kuch likha nahi hai, phir bhi woh kinaare ka hissa hain. Parimap mein har bhuja ki lambai judti hai. Toh is hexagon ka parimap kitna hai?

aapko virat pasand hai?

Iska shuruaati hissa dekhte hain. Baad kinaare par lagti hai, toh teeno bhujayein jodo: P = 7 + 9 + 12, kyunki koi bhi bhuja chhooti toh baad adhoori reh jaayegi. Ab tak samajh aaya?

Pehle do bhujayein jodo: 7 + 9 = 16 m, kyunki ek kone se chalke do bhujayein poori hui, teesri abhi baaki hai. Yeh kadam saaf hai?

director.text: 28 centimetre

Haan, sahi hai. Har bhuja jodna hamesha kaam karta hai. Is 6 cm lambe aur 4 cm chaude aayat mein lambai 6 cm do baar aati hai aur chaudai 4 cm bhi do baar, isliye agle hisse mein uska ek chhota tareeka dekhenge. Chalo, aage badhein?
mujhe lagta hai haan

Is aayat mein upar aur neeche ki bhuja 10 m ki hai, yeh lambai hai. Daayein aur baayein ki bhuja 6 m ki hai, yeh chaudai hai. Aamne-saamne ki bhujayein barabar hain. Board par 10 m aur 6 m ek-ek baar likha hai, par kinaare par chalte hue lambai do baar aati hai aur chaudai bhi do baar. Ab tak samajh aaya?
pata nahi, aap batao
10 m ki lambai do baar: 10 plus 10. 6 m ki chaudai do baar: 6 plus 6. Yeh kadam saaf hai?
pata nahi, aap batao
Lambai do baar jodne par 10 plus 10 hota hai. Chaudai bhi do baar jodne par 6 plus 6 hota hai. Toh is rectangle ka parimap kitna hai?
director.card: Toh is rectangle ka parimap kitna hai?

director.text: 16 m sahi nahi hai. Ek cheenti is aayat ke ek kone se chalti hai, uske paas ek meter hai. 14 m lambai ke baad meter 14 dikhata hai, 6 m chaudai ke baad 20. Ab woh sirf saamne wale kone par hai, aadhe raaste par. Agli lambai ke baad 34, aur aakhri chaudai ke baad 40 m, wapas shuru wale kone par. Cheenti chaar bhujayein chali, lambai + chaudai mein sirf do judti hain. Ab tak samajh aaya?

Yeh aayat 12 m lamba aur 5 m chauda hai. Neeche baayein kone se chalo: 12 m lambai, phir 5 m chaudai, aur tum saamne wale kone par ho. Yeh sirf aadha raasta hai. Baaki aadha raasta bhi utna hi hai. Isliye aayat ka parimap = 2 × (lambai + chaudai). Yeh kadam saaf hai?
